text: Metformin inhibits mTOR signaling and has shown neuroprotective effects in Alzheimer's disease models.
Dysregulation of the mTOR pathway is strongly associated with neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease.
Sildenafil improves vascular function and has potential benefits in metabolic disorders such as Type 2 Diabetes.
Rapamycin directly inhibits mTOR and has been shown to delay neurodegenerative processes.
AMPK activation plays a protective role in Parkinson's disease by maintaining cellular energy balance.
AKT signaling dysregulation contributes to insulin resistance and metabolic disease progression.
